run_extract_frames: run extract_frames.py with a dataset name to extract frames from videos
extract_frame_from_video: extract a single frame from a video at a given global frame index and save it
process_image_for_dataset: process an image tuple for ego4d, yt1b, or sav datasets and extract the frame
resize_and_save_frame: resize a frame to the target image size and save it as an image file
update_annotations_after_extraction: update annotation files to remove invalid frames after extraction is complete
